Container.Name: weather-scout
Container.Overview: Weather Scout: a kid-friendly family weather station with a radar loop, NWS alerts, state 511 road cameras on a map, a Kid Zone with Rocky the raccoon, your own Ecowitt, Ambient or Tempest weather station, and Home Assistant sensors over MQTT. API keys stay on your server.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, settings and cameras.json

Config.Name: Home name
Config.Description: Shown before anyone picks a location

Config.Name: NWS contact
Config.Description: The National Weather Service asks for an app name and contact email

Config.Name: Require sign-in
Config.Description: true = must sign in to see anything

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Optional. Leave blank to create the admin on first visit.

Config.Name: Trust tinyauth headers
Config.Description: Only true when the app is reachable ONLY through tinyauth/your reverse proxy

Config.Name: SSO logout URL
Config.Description: e.g. https://auth.example.com/logout

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: true when served over https

Config.Name: Push alerts
Config.Description: Phone and desktop notifications for NWS alerts. Needs an https address (reverse proxy).

Config.Name: Android app fingerprint
Config.Description: Signing fingerprint of your Weather Scout Android app, so it opens full screen (docs/APPS.md)

Config.Name: Road cameras
Config.Description: Built-in camera feeds: true (VA, SC, MD, KY, DE, plus NC, NY, GA and OH once their free keys are set below), false, or a list like va,md,nc

Config.Name: DriveNC API key (North Carolina cameras)
Config.Description: Free. Make an account at drivenc.gov, then request a developer key at https://www.drivenc.gov/developers/doc and paste it here. Leave blank to skip NC.

Config.Name: 511NY API key (New York cameras)
Config.Description: Free. Make an account at 511ny.org, then request a developer key at https://511ny.org/developers/doc. Leave blank to skip NY.

Config.Name: 511GA API key (Georgia cameras)
Config.Description: Free. Make an account at 511ga.org, then request a developer key at https://511ga.org/developers/doc. Leave blank to skip GA.

Config.Name: OHGO API key (Ohio cameras)
Config.Description: Free. Register at https://publicapi.ohgo.com/docs/registration and paste the key here. Leave blank to skip OH.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Turns on Ask an Expert / Ask Rocky, the cloud photo identifier and AI web search. Key from console.anthropic.com. You can also set this and the other AI and voice settings in the app under Family & settings

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Claude model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5 or claude-haiku-5-5 for lower cost

Config.Name: AI web search
Config.Description: Allow web search in the AI helper (kid-safe science sites only in Kid Mode)

Config.Name: AI daily limit
Config.Description: AI questions and photos per person per day (0 = no limit)

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: anthropic, ollama or off. Blank = whichever is set up (Claude first)

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional. Use your own Ollama for the AI helper instead of Claude, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:11434

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Ollama chat model (pull it first, e.g. ollama pull gemma3)

Config.Name: Ollama vision model
Config.Description: Only if the chat model can't see photos, e.g. qwen2.5vl

Config.Name: Ollama web search key
Config.Description: Free ollama.com key, only for Search the web with Ollama

Config.Name: Kokoro voice URL
Config.Description: Optional. Kokoro-FastAPI container for a natural read-aloud voice, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8880

Config.Name: Kokoro voice
Config.Description: Rocky's default voice, e.g. af_heart, bf_emma, am_adam

Config.Name: Kokoro speed
Config.Description: Speaking speed, 0.5 to 2

Config.Name: Kokoro fallback
Config.Description: When Kokoro can't answer: browser (device voice) or off

Config.Name: Windy map key
Config.Description: Optional. Windy works without it (free embed). A Map Forecast API key from https://api.windy.com/keys turns on the full Windy map; set its domain to your Weather Scout address

Config.Name: Station upload token
Config.Description: Optional. Secret for Ecowitt/Ambient uploads to /api/stations/push/TOKEN. Blank = only direct uploads from your home network

Config.Name: Station names
Config.Description: e.g. ecowitt_3419d586=Backyard (ids are in Family and settings)

Config.Name: Main station
Config.Description: Station id to show first. Blank = the freshest one

Config.Name: Station elevation (m)
Config.Description: For Tempest sea-level pressure

Config.Name: Ambient API key
Config.Description: Optional. Ambient Weather cloud, from ambientweather.net/account

Config.Name: Tempest token
Config.Description: Optional. Personal access token from tempestwx.com/settings/tokens

Config.Name: Tempest station ids
Config.Description: Comma list. Blank = every station on the token

Config.Name: Tempest on the LAN
Config.Description: true = listen for Tempest hub broadcasts on UDP 50222. Needs Host or br0 network

Config.Name: MQTT broker
Config.Description: Optional. Home Assistant sensors with discovery, e.g. mqtt://192.168.1.10:1883

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Optional, instead of MQTT. e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: Long-lived access token (your HA profile, Security)

Config.Name: Home Assistant interval
Config.Description: Seconds between forecast updates (60 or more)
